items.title: Last day to file Widerspruch against the revocation of unemployment benefit
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter dated 2026-08-27 (Thursday). Posting date is not stated, so I assumed it was posted on the letter date. The letter says it counts as announced on the fourth day after posting: 28.08, 29.08, 30.08, 31.08, so Bekanntgabe is Monday 2026-08-31. The one-month period starts the next day (§ 187 (1) BGB, § 26 SGB X) and ends with the same-numbered day of the next month (§ 188 (2) BGB): 2026-09-30, a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so § 193 BGB does not shift it. The objection must reach the Agentur für Arbeit by this day.

warnings: The objection deadline is 2026-09-30, which is today, so an objection must reach the Agentur für Arbeit today (in writing or recorded in person) if you want to file one.
The posting date is not stated in the letter; the deadline assumes it was posted on 2026-08-27, and a later posting date would move the deadline later.
The letter says the August 2026 payment of 1.318,20 € is still to be paid but gives no payment date, so no payment item was created.
The letter is unsigned and gives no reasoning beyond § 48 SGB X; if you did not start a job on 01.09.2026, contact the agency promptly.
